d:
Tu Hi Hai - The third single from Dear Zindagi, is a delightfully warm track all about falling in love and feeling elated.
This lovable track has been composed by Amit Trived and beautifully penned by Kausar Munir.
The soothing voice of Arijit Singh adds that extra soul and charm to this song.
Dear Zindagi releases on 25th November, 2016
Written & Directed by Gauri Shinde
Produced By – Gauri Khan, Karan Johar, Gauri Shinde
Music & Original Score - Amit Trivedi
Director of Photography – Laxman Utekar
